title: [GMCP 203.026.02] Production path: OAuth-capable MCP client and authorization flow
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-026-02. Implement the canonical state, types, and primary production path. Replace stubs, demo-only paths, duplicated semantics, and implicit ambient state; preserve compatible behavior through explicit adapters; and make the new path reachable from the shipped GMCP runtime. Vector outcome: The host completes secure authorization-code flows with PKCE, state and nonce binding, protected-resource discovery, authorization-server selection, exact redirect matching, refresh rotation, revocation, incremental scopes and per-resource credential binding. Dynamic registration is isolated as legacy policy; current client metadata mechanisms, loopback hardening, browser cancellation and concurrent-account flows are interoperable and attack-tested. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
